scope: Woodford, Interest and Prices, Chapter 1: The Return of Monetary Rules. The channel system for the overnight rate with a genuine CDF and the target supply; the Wicksell rule and its difference form; Taylor-rule arithmetic, the Taylor principle and partial-adjustment rules; the neo-Wicksellian price-level model, its unique bounded solution and the exact determinacy region.
source: Michael Woodford, Interest and Prices: Foundations of a Theory of Monetary Policy, Princeton University Press, 2003, Chapter 1, pp. 1-60.
